profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Backend | 12+ years experienced | Master of Computer Science
profile.summary: Knowledgeable software engineer with over 12 years of experience building scalable platforms, applications, and systems for rapidly expanding e-commerce, health care, and tech companies. Experienced successfully managing elite technical and software engineering teams, as well as communicating with clients to gather requirements and feedback. Hands-on technical skill spanning Microservices, Web Services, Golang, and Postgres in fast-paced and deadline-driven environments. Hands-on experience with AWS, and Google Cloud.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- API optimization for cash team
- Apply Advisory lock to handle conflict in millions throughput transactions API

Stacks: Nodejs, Typescript, Postgres, MongoDB, Jest, AWS (Lambda, CloudWatch, DynamoDB,…)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Client Parsley Health:
- Build the EMR Service to consolidate requests to MDHQ
- Abstract the structure to ready for the new EHR without breaking changes in downstream
- Build an Authentication service to validate the password.
- Tech stack: Node js, Golang, GCP

Client PatientPop:
- Understand the healthcare domain
- Build robust, scalable applications with micro-services 
- Propose architect and hands-on work to deliver features on time 
- Tech stack: Node js, Python, PHP, AWS
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Distributed Systems · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices · REST APIs · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Go (Programming Language) · NoSQL · Express.js · AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Node.js

positions.title: Graduate Student Assistant
positions.description: Support another student and professor on the course Web application programing
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · REST APIs · NoSQL · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Played a key role in the programming and development of B2C e-commerce platforms and applications as leader of the technical team.
• Analyze the requirements and give the high level of the architect. Developed the core framework and template for the team.
• Developed the features that increased assortment. Successfully handle more than 20,000 active sellers working on the system.
• Developed applications and modules to streamline complex products and import processes of more than 400,000 new products imported every day, as it saves 7 days on average for sellers compare with manual input by hand on the form.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Data Structures · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · REST APIs · Python (Programming Language) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Project Management · Core Java · NoSQL · Multithreading · Team Leadership · Express.js · PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served on an elite technical team engaged in building online news publications from scratch. 

- Assisted in building a foundational platform for a high-volume news website. 
- Contributed to design, build-out, and maintenance of Teslarati discussion forum as well as iOS and Android apps.
- Deploy the website to AWS using EC2, S3, Route54.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · REST APIs · Python (Programming Language) · Back-End Web Development · NoSQL · MySQL · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) · PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assisted in building new web apps and APIs for large enterprise applications. 

- Constructed a new tool to streamline landing page development with the capacity to generate over 200 landing pages per month. The saved effort of approximately 9 developers. 
- Built a new API version for Tiki Corp mobile, desktop, and web development teams.
- Developed mission-critical API for large enterprise market applications.
- Successfully convert e-commerce platform from magenta 2 to a more scaleable framework (Laravel) in 2 years.
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices · REST APIs · Java · Back-End Web Development · NoSQL · MySQL · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) · PHP · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · Node.js

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
- Main responsibility in company. Propose tech structure and implement for client.
- Talk with clients about requirements, tech detail and lead team to make it come true.
- Make time lime and manage team to meet deadline.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Lead small team as a outsourcing company to work with clients (Singapore/US).
- Hire people and contact with clients.
- Manage staff, trainning, recruitment, projects.
- Customer support.
- Sale and marketing.

positions.title: Mobile & Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed, maintained, and updated applications as a member of the IT development team.
 
- Constructed TOP app with API and iOS functionality. 
- Developed app allowing people to manage and share online movie and theater tickets, as well as contribute to charities.

positions.title: Web Devloper
positions.description:
Developed and maintained features and functionalities for hundreds of mini music websites. 

- Developed API in partnership with the iOS team.
- Played a key role on the mobile development team for iOS music app Motion.
